organizations.description: We are a global industry leader in water logistics and infrastructure, changing the way people think about worldwide water access. Our technique successfully covers rough terrain and gets clean water to the people who need it in a matter of minutes. TOHL reinvents piping infrastructures to minimize disruptions in water supply during emergency response logistics. Earthquakes and other disasters often destroy water infrastructure, with roads and pipes damaged and water trucks unable reach local communities. A Mobile Infrastructure system can be set up hours after a natural disaster, and removed, reused or recycled at convenience. TOHL's solutions seamlessly integrate with conventional emergency response water solutions, moving water to save lives.
